Title: Musical Museum, Brentford (family visit)
ScheduleText: Open Fri, Sat and Sun 10:00–16:00. Guided tours 10:30, 12:30 and 14:30 (subject to guide availability). A Family and Children's Tour is listed for 14 Nov (year, time and age not given)
PriceText: £5 per child; family ticket £20 (1 adult + 2 children) or £30 (2 adults + 3 children)
Description: Museum of self-playing instruments and mechanical music, with guided tours and family events
